extracted.name: Simple Creamy Lemon Chicken Sauce
extracted.description: This simple sauce is made of cream of chicken soup mixed with lemon juice, garlic, and spices. It tastes great on rice, pasta, chicken, or veggies.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Stir chicken soup, water, lemon juice, butter, and garlic powder together in a pan and place over medium heat. Cook until hot, about 5 minutes.
